assets.subject: Linen, worn leather, iron mail and skin albedo for original procedural 3D characters

source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 3D game albedo material texture atlas for Imperium, a restrained painterly historical Roman tactical game. Create one square 2048 by 2048 image, exactly four equal seamless-looking square material samples in a 2 by 2 grid, no gutters, borders, labels, lettering, objects or perspective. Top left quadrant: fine warm ivory natural linen weave, visible irregular threads and subtle wear, low contrast. Top right: dark oxblood brown worn leather, fine creases and pores, muted warm brown. Bottom left: densely interlinked small iron mail rings, believable alternating rows, neutral grey iron with subtle rough metal variation, uniform ring scale, not knit fabric. Bottom right: warm olive Mediterranean human skin microtexture, very subtle pores and natural mottling, no face, no features, no hair, no wounds. Flat diffuse evenly lit material scans, no cast shadows, no directional highlights, no vignette, no dramatic light. Rich carefully painted realistic material detail suitable to wrap over original 3D characters; each quadrant extends fully to all its edges with near matching edge color. All four quadrants exact equal size, useful high quality texture maps, not a moodboard.

assets.usage: The four 627 by 627 quadrants are sampled to 256 by 256 neutralized shared colour maps at runtime; original procedural bump/roughness and failure fallbacks remain. This changes surface colour, not character geometry.
assets.loading: Deferred from initial shell; included in every campaign chapter shared 3D resource group and explicit full download.

export.instructions: Pillow RGB WebP quality84 method6; no resize or creative repainting.
